Design.evidence_source: [004_deciding_on_behalf_of_others_does_not_mitigate_sel_p0003] In Study 1, we varied whether dictators decided under time pressure. We had two conditions: Time Pressure and No Time Pressure. In both conditions, dictators could choose to reveal the recipient’s payoff for option B at no cost. [004_deciding_on_behalf_of_others_does_not_mitigate_sel_p0005] In Study 2, we varied whether dictators decided for themselves or on behalf of another person. We had two conditions: Self and Other.

country.evidence_source: [004_deciding_on_behalf_of_others_does_not_mitigate_sel_p0004] The experiments were conducted at the BonnEconLab at the University of Bonn, Germany. Participants were recruited from the student population of the University of Bonn.
